text: BAM share rose 0.09 percentage points over 26 hours, and rose 0.08 percentage points over 7 days, to 32.7% of Solana stake. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee holds 23.7% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 58 leadership changes in this window should be read as whale-driven routing, not evidence of a structural rollover; only one has been validated to date.
